title: graviton-cert: Machine-Checked Obstructions and Constructive Geometric Matter Emergence in Warped 5D Relational Gravity (Lean 4 Formalization)
description: Open-source Lean 4 verification archive (50/50 kernel-checked theorems across 7 studies, zero sorryAx, zero custom axioms) from the Graviton Research Foundation. Includes the 29-theorem Timeless Gravity & Geometric Origin of Matter formalization (TG-01..12, PW-01..06, GM-01..11) and the camera-ready arXiv LaTeX preprint (paper/main.tex).
